title: Entry
description: What every entry in the taxonomy carries: an id and a body, and below the root the id of its parent one level up. Each level schema extends an entry and narrows its id and its parent to its own level

examples.body: Do every activity at the earliest point where it can be done.

RootEntry.description: An entry at the root level, which has no parent

Entry.description: An entry below the root, pointing at its parent one level up
